name: print-social-dark-market-calendar-cards-with-flags-and-3d-calendar-render
title: Dark 'Market Calendar' post with flag-tagged glass cards and a 3D glass calendar tile
whatItIs: A square black post with ribbed teal-edged background, an 'Events' pill and 'Market Calendar' title, five dark rounded cards each with a date, weekday tag, country flag, bold event name and blue country label, and a sixth card showing a glowing 3D glass calendar render with a blue 'Forex' tag.
whatItMeans: Sleek and data-savvy; the 3D render adds a premium, high-tech touch to a list of events.
techniques: Give each event a card with flag and country label.
Replace one card with a hero render.
Use ribbed vertical texture with edge glows as a backdrop.

vocabulary.definition: A standout 3D image in a grid.
